topic: Guitarist's name in the Fearless bio (resolved)
summary: The Fearless bio (S1) prints 'guitarist Tyler Foiles'. A band member confirms that is a typo: the lineup is Tyler Smyth (guitar) and Taylor Foiles (bass), matching S6, S15 and S17, and the quote in the bio is Tyler Smyth's (S22).

topic: Masters of the Universe track count
summary: Fearless (S21) lists 13 tracks; MusicBrainz (S3) and Discogs (S6, an MP3 edition) list 14, adding 'Fade Out (alternate version)'. This archive shows the 13 official tracks and notes the extra on the digital edition.
S15 prints 'St. Paul, MI'; St. Paul is in Minnesota, so 'MI' looks like a typo. Shown as Minnesota with the source spelling noted.
Concert Archives (S18) lists two consecutive Salt Lake City dates (Oct 22 'The Basement', Oct 23 'Avalon Theater'). Unresolved.
Concert Archives (S18) lists a multi-band event dated 2015-01-01 that includes Let's Get It, although the band is recorded as ended in 2012. Treated as unverified.

Archived MySpace (S9, S10) lists the label as 'Unsigned' in August 2008 (S9) and January 2009 (S10); S1 says the band signed about a year after forming. Consistent, but the exact signing date is unknown.

Concert Archives (S18) lists the festival on both 2009-07-29 and 2009-08-29 at the same Pittsburgh venue; the band's own schedule (S11) says 2009-08-29. The July date looks like a mis-dated duplicate.

The 2010 press release (S15) and Concert Archives (S18) disagree on several dates: Aug 6-7 appear in S18 as Transmission Festival / Scream It Like You Mean It bills; Aug 10 (S15: Trocadero Upstairs, Philadelphia; S18: The Balcony); Aug 14 (S15: Evansville; S18: Indianapolis); Aug 15 (S15: La Crosse; S18: Madison); Aug 17 (S18: La Crosse). Both readings are kept in the tour archive.
Concert Archives (S18) lists both The Met, Pawtucket and Club Hell, Providence on 2009-08-07; the band's own schedule (S11) says Club Hell, Providence.

The band owner gives A&R (S22); a public profile snippet describes marketing and promotions at Fearless (S28). A band-channel video titled 'Our A&R Nate wrestling with Chris' (2010-09-25, S29) supports an A&R contact named Nate, but does not give the surname. Unresolved; possibly different periods.

topic: When the band signed to Fearless
summary: The Fearless bio (S1) says the band signed 'just after the band's one-year anniversary' (about summer 2009), and the band owner approves that wording (S22). The band's own MySpace called the label 'Unsigned' in August 2008 and January 2009 (S9, S10), yet a draft Fearless recording deal memo in the band's files is headed 'as of January __, 2009' (S37). A draft's 'as of' date is not the signing date, so the actual date remains unknown.
